text:
I understand you have your order number handy, but I need to authenticate your identity first before I can help with any order-related requests. 

Could you try to remember your email address? It would be something like yourname@example.com. If you can't remember your email, I can also authenticate you using your first name, last name, and zip code instead.
zh:
我理解你有訂單號在手邊，但在我幫助任何訂單相關請求之前，我需要先核實你的身份。 

你能試著記住你的電子郵件地址嗎？它可能是你名字@example.com這樣的格式。如果你不記得你的電子郵件地址，我也可以使用你的名字、姓氏和郵政編碼來替代核實你。(滑板 #W1234567)
